---
title: Read a price in your contract
description: Find, check and use a feed cell in a CKB script.
---

Add [`lean-oracle-common`](/docs/reference/rust) to your script, then:

```rust
use ckb_std::{ckb_constants::Source, high_level::{load_cell_data, load_cell_type_hash, QueryIter}};
use lean_oracle_common::consumer::{check_feed_cell, price_at_expo};

fn read_price(feed_type_hash: [u8; 32], feed_id: [u8; 32], committee: [u8; 32]) -> Result<i64, i8> {
    // Find the pinned feed cell among the cell deps.
    let index = QueryIter::new(load_cell_type_hash, Source::CellDep)
        .position(|hash| hash == Some(feed_type_hash))
        .ok_or(ERROR_FEED_MISSING)?;
    let data = load_cell_data(index, Source::CellDep).map_err(|_| ERROR_FEED_MISSING)?;

    // Right feed, right committee, and a verified price.
    let feed = check_feed_cell(&data, &feed_id, &committee).map_err(|_| ERROR_FEED_INVALID)?;

    // Your freshness rule goes here; see "Check freshness".

    // In the units you want, e.g. cents.
    price_at_expo(&feed, -2).ok_or(ERROR_PRICE_SCALE)
}
```

- Get the three hashes from your own configuration: the feed cell's type hash (from
  [creating it](/docs/build/guides/create-feed-cell)), the feed ID from
  [Price feeds](/docs/feeds), and the committee type hash from
  [Networks](/docs/reference/networks).
- If the feed cell is updated in the same transaction, read it from `Source::Output` instead.
- `feed` also has `conf`, `ema_price`, `publish_time_ms` and `num_publishers`.

The [tutorial](/docs/build/tutorial) shows a complete script.
